title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཨ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 109)
shelf_note: Canonical classical Tibetan Madhyamaka commentary folio matching the Derge Tengyur collection and volume metadata.

ocr_errors.problem: OCR uncertainty parenthetical variant notation embedded into running text
Vowel misread: 'མི་' (mi) instead of 'མེ་' (me, fire/heat of remorse)

tr_errors_A.problem: Misinterprets phonetic transliteration of Sanskrit laṅghana (destruction/perishing of entities) as 'executioner'

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B is more rigorous and accurate, correctly identifying the Sanskrit transliteration 'la gha nya' (laṅghana) and preserving the technical nuance of Buddhist philosophical citations.

book_verdict: Authentic Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka folio with clear woodblock carving, highly accurate OCR, and an excellent, scholarly translation in Version B.
